assertions.subject: search:greedy
assertions.claim: Dead forever: greedy search reaches 0.675 matmul cosine against Viterbi's 0.963, and it silently disables rotation so a greedy artifact reports inflated speed.

assertions.why: Scored against the wrong budget class. K=4/V=4 is 1.0 bpw because bpw = K/V (mistralrs-quant/src/qtip/mod.rs:376-381), and the rung was compared against a 2-bpw budget - so the 1,413 tok/s figure, the '1.38 inst/wt at budget' claim and the 'full 16,602 recoverable' corollary all describe a model we are not shipping. Also note the re-bake does NOT get cheaper at higher K: the production baker is beam, not exhaustive (213 vs 8,257 s/layer on A100) and is issue-bound, so cost goes as (n/V) x W x 2^K, about 8x MORE at K=8/V=4/L=12 - roughly 1,700 s/layer, 20 hours, $30.
